PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Ground stakeholder and mission intent in authoritative, current evidence
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Hall's problem-definition and goal-setting tradition; NASA stakeholder-expectations practice; requirements-engineering work on environment and agreement.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Identify customer objectives and translate them into system goals before detailed design.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Component teams can optimise a technically impressive solution that does not solve the governing mission or current stakeholder problem.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Solution success is asserted against an unauthorised, stale or internally invented notion of value.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Record the intended outcomes, sources, decision authority, conflicts, use context, assumptions and current validation evidence; make downstream decisions point back to that governed intent.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Multiple stakeholders; costly or irreversible design; regulated/contractual commitments; uncertain mission; long lifecycle; changed operating context.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a small reversible task with one empowered user and immediate feedback, a dated goal statement plus direct confirmation is enough.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Access to representative stakeholders or mission evidence; explicit system boundary and intended lifecycle; a means to resolve or preserve disagreement.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: The governing need, stakeholder classes, intended use and current context must be identifiable; latent/absent stakeholders are a declared limitation.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: A named person, body, law, contract or mission authority must be able to legitimise or change the governing intent; facilitation is not authority.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: The intent record, source and applicable system/configuration/time horizon must be versioned.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: External actors, environments and ecosystem dependencies that affect intent must be within scope.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Validation evidence must be capable of challenging the stated need and intended-use model.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Solution success is asserted against an unauthorised, stale or internally invented notion of value. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Mission owner, product owner, architecture authority, requirements authority and validation authority.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Solution-biased framing; token stakeholder participation; stale authority; proxy outcomes; hidden conflicts; retrospective rationalisation.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Stakeholder workshops and CONOPS documents can create consensus theatre; stated requests may reflect politics, solution bias or absent users.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Preserve requirement provenance, authority and rationale
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Requirements traceability lineage; Gotel/Finkelstein pre-specification traceability; current 29148 guidance.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Link each requirement to its source document or stakeholder.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A requirement remains active after its source, authority or rationale has changed; a trace link exists but cannot answer why the requirement governs.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: An arbitrary or obsolete requirement consumes design, test and certification effort.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Record source identity/version, issuing authority, rationale, assumptions, conflicts, decision history and validity conditions; challenge provenance before downstream conformance.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Large or long-lived baselines; regulated/contracted work; reused requirements; multiple issuers; frequent change.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a directly confirmed, low-cost request, source, date and owner may be sufficient.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: A governed need/source model, identifiable authors/owners, change mechanism and downstream design/V&V consumers.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: Requirements must inherit legitimacy from validated need, contract/regulation or explicitly authorised design constraints.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: Issuing, approving, interpreting and waiving authority must be distinguished.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Each requirement set and relation must identify version, baseline, applicability and supersession.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Allocations and cross-boundary requirements require explicit interface ownership and composition checks.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Feasibility and verification method must be considered, while validation remains separate from testability.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: An arbitrary or obsolete requirement consumes design, test and certification effort. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Requirements authority, architect, implementing team, interface owner, change authority, verifier and validator.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: False completeness; ambiguous authority; stylistic compliance; over-decomposition; stale traces; ungoverned volatility; requirement inflation.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Maintaining rationale is costly and can expose politically sensitive disagreement; source authority can still be illegitimate.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Original form: Link each requirement to its source document or stakeholder. Evolved under criticism into: Semantic provenance that supports legitimacy and change decisions, not merely backward hyperlinks.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Semantic provenance that supports legitimacy and change decisions, not merely backward hyperlinks.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Templates, shall-statements, databases and RTMs are optional. The property is a justified, current and usable constraint/claim.
PROPERTIES.EMPIRICAL_OR_DOMAIN_EVIDENCE: Strong conceptual and practitioner evidence; direct task-benefit evidence exists for maintained traceability generally.
PROPERTIES.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Trace completeness is difficult and sources may conflict or be tacit.
PROPERTIES.OPEN_QUESTIONS: What minimum provenance captures enough decision value without creating permanent clerical burden?

PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Stable, well-understood repeat work may baseline early and manage only exceptions.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Manage assumptions as owned, testable and expiring engineering claims
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Requirements environment/domain distinctions; contract-based design; model-credibility practice.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Document assumptions underlying requirements and designs.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A component, model, trade or reused design works only under an implicit condition that no one owns or rechecks.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Ariane-style reuse, interface mismatch or invalid model inference occurs while all explicit requirements appear satisfied.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Represent each material assumption with owner, source, affected claims, test/monitor, expiry/review condition and response if false.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Reuse; supplier boundaries; uncertain environment; models/simulation; long lifecycle; autonomous constituents.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For local reversible work, state the one or two assumptions that could overturn the decision and test them directly.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Defined relation types, owners, source identities, current configurations and real decisions that consume the relation.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: Relations must ultimately connect to authorised needs or explicitly bounded engineering assumptions.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: Someone must be authorised to create, challenge, expire and waive the relation or assumption.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Both endpoints, semantics and validity interval/configuration must be identified.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Cross-boundary assumptions require two-sided confirmation and composition evidence.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Material assumptions need a falsification, monitoring or validation plan; trace semantics need sampling/challenge.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Ariane-style reuse, interface mismatch or invalid model inference occurs while all explicit requirements appear satisfied. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Change analyst, maintainer, architect, verifier, integration lead and assurance authority.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Link-count gaming; stale endpoints; semantically false links; orphaned assumptions; unbounded registers; automation false positives.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Assumption registers become dumping grounds; unknown unknowns cannot be listed; owners may lack authority to observe the condition.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Original form: Document assumptions underlying requirements and designs. Evolved under criticism into: Assumption currentness is a first-class relation separate from ordinary traceability, with explicit falsification and change propagation.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Assumption currentness is a first-class relation separate from ordinary traceability, with explicit falsification and change propagation.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Trace matrices and assumption logs are optional. The property is a current, meaningful and challengeable relation.
PROPERTIES.EMPIRICAL_OR_DOMAIN_EVIDENCE: Strong mishap, formal and guidance support; comparative field measurement remains limited.
PROPERTIES.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Completeness is impossible and testability varies.
PROPERTIES.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should assumption exposure be prioritised when the potential set is unbounded?

REQUIREMENTS_PROFILE.PROPERTY: Manage assumptions as owned, testable and expiring engineering claims
REQUIREMENTS_PROFILE.NEED_OR_SOURCE: Must resolve to current stakeholder/mission evidence or an explicitly authorised constraint; for rejected candidates, this is the missing stronger relation.
REQUIREMENTS_PROFILE.REQUIREMENT_FORM: Structured text, model, contract, scenario, constraint, testable property or other fit-for-purpose representation; no mandatory template.
REQUIREMENTS_PROFILE.PROVENANCE: Source identity, version, rationale and derivation are required where the property can govern downstream work.
REQUIREMENTS_PROFILE.ASSUMPTIONS: Material assumptions are explicit, owned and linked to falsification/expiry conditions.
REQUIREMENTS_PROFILE.AUTHORITY: Someone must be authorised to create, challenge, expire and waive the relation or assumption.
REQUIREMENTS_PROFILE.TRACEABILITY: Only semantic relations needed by source, impact, implementation or evidence consumers; link presence alone is insufficient.
REQUIREMENTS_PROFILE.VALIDATION_PRECONDITION: The governing need and intended use remain current enough to justify the requirement.
REQUIREMENTS_PROFILE.VERIFICATION_PRECONDITION: The claim and applicable configuration are precise enough for a discriminating evidence method.
REQUIREMENTS_PROFILE.CHANGE_PROFILE: Versioned; impacts and evidence are invalidated/reconfirmed after relevant source, assumption, architecture, interface or configuration change.
REQUIREMENTS_PROFILE.CHEAP_PATH: For local reversible work, state the one or two assumptions that could overturn the decision and test them directly.
REQUIREMENTS_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Assumption currentness is a first-class relation separate from ordinary traceability, with explicit falsification and change propagation.

ARCHITECTURE_DECISION_PROFILE.CONFIGURATION: Both endpoints, semantics and validity interval/configuration must be identified.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Maintain semantic, consumer-driven traceability
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Requirements-traceability research and standards.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Create bidirectional links among needs, requirements, design, implementation and tests.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Links are absent when change-impact or maintenance decisions need them, or present but stale/semantically false.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: A complete matrix gives false confidence while engineers still cannot answer source, consequence or evidence questions.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Define trace types and validity rules around real decisions; maintain selectively; include source/configuration/currentness; sample or challenge semantics rather than count links.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Many artefacts/teams; high change cost; certification; maintenance; cross-level impact analysis.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For small co-located work, deterministic naming, version control and direct inspection may answer the needed question more cheaply.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Defined relation types, owners, source identities, current configurations and real decisions that consume the relation.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: Relations must ultimately connect to authorised needs or explicitly bounded engineering assumptions.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: Someone must be authorised to create, challenge, expire and waive the relation or assumption.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Both endpoints, semantics and validity interval/configuration must be identified.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Cross-boundary assumptions require two-sided confirmation and composition evidence.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Material assumptions need a falsification, monitoring or validation plan; trace semantics need sampling/challenge.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: A complete matrix gives false confidence while engineers still cannot answer source, consequence or evidence questions. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Change analyst, maintainer, architect, verifier, integration lead and assurance authority.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Link-count gaming; stale endpoints; semantically false links; orphaned assumptions; unbounded registers; automation false positives.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Trace maintenance cost, tool fragmentation and collaboration barriers are substantial; automated links can produce false positives.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Original form: Create bidirectional links among needs, requirements, design, implementation and tests. Evolved under criticism into: A current semantic relation with a named consumer and invalidation rules, independent of spreadsheet or model tooling.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A current semantic relation with a named consumer and invalidation rules, independent of spreadsheet or model tooling.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Trace matrices and assumption logs are optional. The property is a current, meaningful and challengeable relation.
PROPERTIES.EMPIRICAL_OR_DOMAIN_EVIDENCE: A controlled study shows material maintenance benefits; practitioner research documents equally material adoption costs.
PROPERTIES.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Controlled benefits are task-specific and do not justify maximal coverage.
PROPERTIES.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Which trace relations have positive expected value for each decision class?

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Justify derived requirements and allocations
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Hierarchical decomposition/allocation in aerospace SE; requirements engineering domain/machine reasoning.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Flow system requirements down to subsystems and allocate budgets/functions.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Derived requirements acquire authority merely because they appear in a lower-level specification; allocations conflict or erase system interactions.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Subsystems meet their assigned numbers while the integrated system misses mission performance.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: For each derivation/allocation, preserve the parent objective, analysis/rationale, assumptions, interface consequences, margin and verification path; reallocate under change.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Multi-level systems; shared resources; supplier contracts; tight budgets; safety/performance constraints.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: A small indivisible implementation can keep a direct design rationale instead of formal allocation trees.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: A governed need/source model, identifiable authors/owners, change mechanism and downstream design/V&V consumers.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: Requirements must inherit legitimacy from validated need, contract/regulation or explicitly authorised design constraints.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: Issuing, approving, interpreting and waiving authority must be distinguished.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Each requirement set and relation must identify version, baseline, applicability and supersession.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Allocations and cross-boundary requirements require explicit interface ownership and composition checks.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Feasibility and verification method must be considered, while validation remains separate from testability.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Subsystems meet their assigned numbers while the integrated system misses mission performance. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Requirements authority, architect, implementing team, interface owner, change authority, verifier and validator.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: False completeness; ambiguous authority; stylistic compliance; over-decomposition; stale traces; ungoverned volatility; requirement inflation.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Top-down flow-down can overconstrain design and conceal emergent interactions; false numerical precision is common.

PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Architecture evaluation frameworks and trade-off analysis methods.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Conduct architecture reviews against requirements and quality attributes.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: An approved architecture has not been challenged under realistic scenarios, sensitivities or failure interactions.

PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Use consequence-proportionate scenarios, prototypes, models, independent challenge and trade-off analysis; record risks and what evidence would retire them.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Novel architecture; high consequence; expensive rework; competing quality attributes; uncertain technology.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Routine architecture with close precedent can use targeted review of deltas and deterministic checks.

PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Responsibilities, interfaces, shared resources and cross-cutting interactions must be analysed.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Consequential claims require scenario, prototype, analysis, model or integration evidence and reopening conditions.

PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Diagram substitution; post-hoc rationale; stale decisions; local optimisation; arbitrary decomposition; quality-attribute omission; architecture erosion.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Generate real alternatives before consequential commitment
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Systems analysis, Hall methodology, trade-study practice and set-based design.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Generate candidate systems and compare them before selecting a concept.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: The preferred option is presented as inevitable, with token alternatives constructed after criteria are known.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Trade studies legitimate predetermined choices and foreclose superior architectures.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Establish a decision frame and minimum diversity of plausible alternatives; include do-nothing/reference options; reveal dominated or infeasible choices transparently.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Architecture down-select; technology selection; high irreversibility; uncertain solution space.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: When only one option is legally/physically possible, verify that constraint rather than fabricate alternatives.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: A legitimate decision frame, decision authority, feasible alternatives, criteria tied to stakeholder value, uncertainty information and decision deadline.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: Criteria and constraints must inherit authority from current mission/stakeholder commitments.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: The analyst recommends; the authorised decision maker decides and owns value judgements.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Inputs, alternatives, evidence and decision version must be frozen enough to reproduce the argument.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Cross-system consequences and coupled alternatives must be represented where material.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Claims used to discriminate alternatives need fit-for-purpose data, prototypes, analysis or tests.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Trade studies legitimate predetermined choices and foreclose superior architectures. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Architecture/technology selection authority and stakeholders bearing the consequences.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Predetermined alternatives; hidden criteria; weight gaming; false precision; stale inputs; analysis paralysis; unrecorded reversibility.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Alternative generation can consume time indefinitely, and political/contract constraints may make the option set fictitious.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Original form: Generate candidate systems and compare them before selecting a concept. Evolved under criticism into: Alternative generation is a falsifiable search for materially different feasible means, scaled to decision consequence.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Alternative generation is a falsifiable search for materially different feasible means, scaled to decision consequence.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Trade matrices and formal studies are optional. The property is an honest, uncertainty-aware comparison that changes a consequential choice.
PROPERTIES.EMPIRICAL_OR_DOMAIN_EVIDENCE: Long lineage and strong decision-theory rationale; comparative engineering trials limited.
PROPERTIES.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: No method ensures the best unimagined alternative is found.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Test trade decisions for uncertainty, sensitivity and false precision
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: RAND systems analysis, decision analysis, technical trade studies and sensitivity-analysis critique.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Score alternatives against weighted criteria.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Small arbitrary changes in weights, estimates or assumptions reverse the winner while the scorecard displays a precise rank.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Decision makers mistake arithmetic output for objective truth.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Expose ranges, uncertainty, correlations, non-compensable constraints and rank reversals; test multiple plausible weight/value structures; preserve qualitative judgement.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Multi-attribute choices; uncertain data; close alternatives; political stakeholder weights.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: A cheap deterministic discriminator can end the study immediately when one option violates a hard constraint or clearly dominates.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: A legitimate decision frame, decision authority, feasible alternatives, criteria tied to stakeholder value, uncertainty information and decision deadline.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: Criteria and constraints must inherit authority from current mission/stakeholder commitments.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: The analyst recommends; the authorised decision maker decides and owns value judgements.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Inputs, alternatives, evidence and decision version must be frozen enough to reproduce the argument.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Cross-system consequences and coupled alternatives must be represented where material.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Claims used to discriminate alternatives need fit-for-purpose data, prototypes, analysis or tests.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Decision makers mistake arithmetic output for objective truth. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Architecture/technology selection authority and stakeholders bearing the consequences.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Predetermined alternatives; hidden criteria; weight gaming; false precision; stale inputs; analysis paralysis; unrecorded reversibility.

PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Assign owning parties, approving authority, escalation path, configuration responsibility and shared verification obligations for each consequential interface.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Supplier/organisation boundary; independent teams; physical integration; SoS; regulated handoff.

PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: External/user/ecosystem semantics must reflect intended operations, not only internal schemas.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: Each side's authority and the joint resolution/escalation path must be explicit.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Both endpoint versions, contract version and environment must be identified.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Physical, logical, data, timing, state, organisational and authority dimensions are considered as applicable.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Interface claims require joint verification/integration evidence under relevant states, limits and failure conditions.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Plan integration strategy, sequence and readiness
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Aerospace/space programme integration and NASA lifecycle practice.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Create an assembly, integration and test plan for bottom-up system realisation.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Products arrive in an order or maturity state that blocks useful integration, hides high-risk interfaces or consumes scarce facilities inefficiently.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: The first system-level composition occurs after architecture and supplier choices are hard to change.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Order integration by risk, dependency and learning value; define entry evidence, facilities, configurations, owners, fallback paths and anomaly flow.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Multiple components/suppliers; scarce testbeds; hardware/software coupling; high integration risk.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Two-component low-risk work may integrate directly under a short checklist.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Defined interfaces/configurations, integration authority, suitable environments, entry evidence, anomaly process and feasible sequencing.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: Integration must exercise the mission/use interactions that matter, not only convenient assembly paths.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: Someone must control integration configuration, sequence, facilities, discrepancy disposition and stop/go decisions.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Every integration result must identify products, software/data, environment, tools and configuration.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Risky semantic, timing, physical, organisational and state interfaces are first-class targets.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Integration evidence is not automatically verification or validation; claims, coverage and limitations must be stated.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: The first system-level composition occurs after architecture and supplier choices are hard to change. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Integration lead, architecture/interface owners, V&V authorities, release authority and operators.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Late big-bang composition; low-fidelity surrogate overclaim; schedule-driven readiness waivers; anomaly closure theatre; component-pass/system-fail.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Detailed plans become obsolete; readiness criteria can be gamed; schedule pressure encourages paper waivers.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Original form: Create an assembly, integration and test plan for bottom-up system realisation. Evolved under criticism into: A living risk/learning strategy that determines what is combined next and why, rather than a date-driven final-assembly schedule.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A living risk/learning strategy that determines what is combined next and why, rather than a date-driven final-assembly schedule.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Integration plans and readiness reviews are optional carriers. The property is early enough, risk-ranked composition evidence.
PROPERTIES.EMPIRICAL_OR_DOMAIN_EVIDENCE: Strong programme guidance and case evidence; comparative sequence studies are scarce.
PROPERTIES.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Integration sequence optimisation is often heuristic and resource-constrained.
PROPERTIES.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should learning value, failure containment and facility scarcity be traded in sequence design?

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Integrate early, incrementally and at risky boundaries
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Concurrent engineering, programme lessons, software continuous integration and agile/iterative SE.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Assemble the complete system after components pass lower-level verification.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Late 'big bang' integration reveals incompatible assumptions after local designs and contracts are entrenched.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Composition defects drive rework, delay and blame across organisational boundaries.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Create the earliest affordable compositions—physical, simulated, emulated or contractual—then increase fidelity and scope; prioritise interfaces and emergent behaviours.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Novel interactions; distributed teams; change-prone software; high coupling; long supplier chains.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Where physical integration is destructive or extraordinarily costly, use earlier models/fixtures and fewer evidence-rich physical events.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Distinguish verification from validation
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Long-standing testing/quality distinctions codified in NASA, IEEE and lifecycle standards.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Verify conformance to specified requirements and validate satisfaction of intended use/needs.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Passing requirements is treated as proof that the right system was built, or user acceptance is treated as proof of every technical requirement.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: A conforming system fails its mission, or an attractive demonstration conceals technical nonconformance.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Maintain separate claims, authorities, contexts and evidence for specified correctness and use/mission fitness; connect but do not collapse them.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Any consequential system; especially where requirements may be wrong, incomplete or stale.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For tiny direct-user work, one feedback event may simultaneously inform both questions, but the two claims remain distinct.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Explicit claims, authoritative baseline, fit-for-purpose environment/data, independent or competent evaluators and anomaly/limitation handling.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: Validation claims require current intended use and representative stakeholders/operations.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: Technical evidence authority, acceptance authority and need/mission authority must not be conflated.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Claim, item configuration, procedure/model/tool/data and environment must be fixed and recoverable.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: System and cross-boundary claims require composition evidence, not only component results.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Tailor systems-engineering depth to consequence, complexity, uncertainty and reversibility
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Lifecycle standards, defence pathway tailoring, agile SE and very-small-entity profiles.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Tailor standard processes and artefacts to project size and lifecycle.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Full ceremony is imposed on cheap reversible work, or critical cross-boundary work is declared 'agile' and left without adequate evidence.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Engineering effort is either wasted or underpowered relative to actual risk.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Scale representation, authority, independence, traceability, modelling, review and V&V to consequence, coupling, novelty, distribution, irreversibility and evidence fragility; retain a documented cheap path.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Every project; especially heterogeneous portfolios and mixed hardware/software.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Local reversible work should use direct evidence, short records and immediate feedback unless a trigger appears.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: A transparent trigger model, authority to tailor, minimum non-waivable obligations and feedback on actual engineering outcomes.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: Consequence and value are judged against current stakeholder/mission commitments.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: Tailoring decisions require named authority and cannot be self-exemption by the work producer alone where consequence is high.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Applicable lifecycle, product, change and evidence scope must be identified.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Coupling, organisational distribution and interface complexity are core escalation triggers.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Evidence fragility, consequence and reversibility determine review/V&V depth.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Engineering effort is either wasted or underpowered relative to actual risk. PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Original form: Tailor standard processes and artefacts to project size and lifecycle. Evolved under criticism into: A trigger-based assurance architecture with explicit escalation and de-escalation, not project-size folklore or blanket waivers.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Engineer distributed authority and federated governance in systems of systems
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Maier's SoS definition, DoD SoS guidance and ISO 21839.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Coordinate constituent-system managers under a SoS capability office.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A central architecture assumes authority it does not possess; constituents optimise local missions and schedules.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Global capability plans fail because dependencies cannot be compelled or synchronised.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Map real decision rights, incentives, commitments, escalation, voluntary standards and fallback options; design governance around managerial and operational independence.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Constituent systems have independent ownership, resources, goals and lifecycle.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Ordinary multi-team systems under one enforceable authority should use normal interface/configuration governance instead.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Demonstrated operational and managerial independence, mission-level dependence, constituent identities, real authority map and communication mechanisms.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: Global mission legitimacy and each constituent's local stakeholders/goals must both be represented.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: Central authority limits, constituent sovereignty, incentives, agreements and escalation must be explicit.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Constituent versions, membership, compatibility and mission configurations change asynchronously and must be tracked.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Interoperability spans technical, semantic, organisational and policy interfaces.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Mission-thread and runtime/operational evidence must supplement constituent verification.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Global capability plans fail because dependencies cannot be compelled or synchronised. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Mission/capability owner, constituent owners, interoperability/integration authorities and operators.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Fictional central control; voluntary compliance without incentive; stale global architecture; local optimisation; asynchronous drift; untestable dynamic compositions.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Governance frameworks often lack enforceable authority and can become coordination forums without consequence.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Original form: Coordinate constituent-system managers under a SoS capability office. Evolved under criticism into: Federated governance that states where authority ends and uses incentives/contracts/evidence rather than fictional central control.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Federated governance that states where authority ends and uses incentives/contracts/evidence rather than fictional central control.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: SoS boards and architecture frameworks are optional. The property is federated coordination under real independence and evolving composition.
PROPERTIES.EMPIRICAL_OR_DOMAIN_EVIDENCE: Strong definitional/guidance support; outcome evidence is largely case-based.
PROPERTIES.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: No general mechanism resolves persistent conflict among sovereign constituents.
PROPERTIES.OPEN_QUESTIONS: What minimum commitments make global mission claims legitimate in a voluntary SoS?

PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Wymore's formal MBSE lineage, NASA modelling and modern MBSE.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Replace document-centric SE with a coherent system model.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A large model is built because MBSE is mandated but does not improve analysis, coordination, change or V&V.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Model maintenance adds cost while real decisions continue in slides, spreadsheets and tacit knowledge.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Define model questions, users, decisions and generated evidence before modelling; choose scope/language/fidelity accordingly; measure use and retire unused views.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: High relationship density; repeated analysis; multiple viewpoints; automation/interchange opportunity; long lifecycle.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a simple project, structured text, tables, executable tests or sketches may be superior.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Named model questions/consumers, governance, skilled users, versioning, tool/data access, validation and sustainable maintenance economics.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: Models must represent authorised needs/use and disclose omitted stakeholders/context.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: Authority is claim-specific; tool/repository ownership does not grant truth authority.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Model, metamodel, tool, data, transformation, implementation and physical referent versions must be related.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Semantic interoperability, transformation loss, APIs and supplier/tool boundaries must be tested.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Intended use, verification, validation, uncertainty, provenance, currentness and permissible inference are mandatory for consequential use.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Model maintenance adds cost while real decisions continue in slides, spreadsheets and tacit knowledge. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Engineers/analysts making decisions, integrators, V&V authorities, operators and lifecycle data users.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Model volume; staleness; tool lock-in; inconsistent repositories; semantic loss; perceived-benefit bias; automated false coherence; inaccessible expertise.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Systematic reviews find claimed benefits often perceived, adoption costly and metrics immature.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Original form: Replace document-centric SE with a coherent system model. Evolved under criticism into: Decision-driven modelling with explicit consumers, quality criteria, configuration and measured use; MBSE branding is irrelevant.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Decision-driven modelling with explicit consumers, quality criteria, configuration and measured use; MBSE branding is irrelevant.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Federate models semantically and preserve representation portability
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Semantic interoperability, model federation and SysML/API standardisation.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Exchange models among tools through common formats and maintain a model repository.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Tools exchange files or identifiers while meanings, constraints, behaviour and provenance are lost or transformed silently.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: A digital thread presents connected artefacts that are not semantically equivalent.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Define canonical semantics/ontologies where justified; test transformations; record losses; expose inconsistency; preserve export/API access and tool-exit paths.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Multiple engineering disciplines/tools/suppliers; long-lived data; regulated handover; acquisition lock-in risk.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: One-team/one-tool short-lived work can use a stable open export and documented schema.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Named model questions/consumers, governance, skilled users, versioning, tool/data access, validation and sustainable maintenance economics.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: Models must represent authorised needs/use and disclose omitted stakeholders/context.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: Authority is claim-specific; tool/repository ownership does not grant truth authority.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Model, metamodel, tool, data, transformation, implementation and physical referent versions must be related.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Semantic interoperability, transformation loss, APIs and supplier/tool boundaries must be tested.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Intended use, verification, validation, uncertainty, provenance, currentness and permissible inference are mandatory for consequential use.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: A digital thread presents connected artefacts that are not semantically equivalent. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Engineers/analysts making decisions, integrators, V&V authorities, operators and lifecycle data users.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Model volume; staleness; tool lock-in; inconsistent repositories; semantic loss; perceived-benefit bias; automated false coherence; inaccessible expertise.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Universal ontologies are costly and politically contested; standards lag tools; strict consistency can impede parallel work.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Original form: Exchange models among tools through common formats and maintain a model repository. Evolved under criticism into: Plural specialised models connected by tested semantic mappings and portable identities—not forced monolithic modelling.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Plural specialised models connected by tested semantic mappings and portable identities—not forced monolithic modelling.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: SysML, repositories, digital threads and twins are optional technologies. The property is decision-relevant, credible, current and portable structured knowledge.
PROPERTIES.EMPIRICAL_OR_DOMAIN_EVIDENCE: Strong standards/formal rationale; empirical multi-tool fidelity and ROI are weak.
PROPERTIES.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: SysML v2/API standardisation is current, but field interoperability evidence is not yet mature.

PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Lifecycle SE and concurrent engineering.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Plan manufacturing, test, deployment, operation, maintenance, support and disposal alongside the end product.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: The delivered product works only with unavailable test equipment, untrained operators, fragile logistics or unplanned disposal/support.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Local product optimisation shifts cost and failure into later lifecycle stages or enabling systems.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Model critical enabling systems, stakeholders, interfaces, resources and constraints early enough to influence architecture and evidence.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Long-lived physical systems; specialised operations; maintainability/logistics; certification; hazardous disposal.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For short-lived software/services using standard infrastructure, capture only enabling dependencies that can alter feasibility or operation.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Defined lifecycle/system boundary, representative lifecycle stakeholders, dependency/economic rationale and configuration/feedback mechanisms.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: Operators, maintainers, manufacturers, support, disposal, regulators and portfolio/mission actors are included only where materially affected.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: Authority across lifecycle organisations and product-family/mission boundaries must be explicit.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Product variants, enabling systems, operational populations and lifecycle states must be identifiable.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Enabling-system, human, platform and mission dependencies are treated as interfaces/compositions.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Operational, maintainability, variability and mission evidence must match the claimed lifecycle scope.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Local product optimisation shifts cost and failure into later lifecycle stages or enabling systems. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Product/mission owner, architect, operations/support, platform governance and lifecycle authorities.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Unbounded scope; speculative future modelling; commonality overreach; lifecycle stakeholder tokenism; duplication with programme/logistics functions.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Lifecycle scope can expand without bound; future support/disposal assumptions are uncertain.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Original form: Plan manufacturing, test, deployment, operation, maintenance, support and disposal alongside the end product. Evolved under criticism into: Selective whole-lifecycle inclusion driven by consequence and dependency, not exhaustive lifecycle documentation.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Selective whole-lifecycle inclusion driven by consequence and dependency, not exhaustive lifecycle documentation.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Lifecycle plans, HSI plans and mission-thread artefacts are optional. The property is early inclusion of dependencies that materially change system decisions.
PROPERTIES.EMPIRICAL_OR_DOMAIN_EVIDENCE: Strong historical/programme guidance; causal comparative evidence mixed.

PROPERTIES.OPEN_QUESTIONS: What lifecycle dependencies are material enough to enter the architecture baseline?

PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Human-systems integration and systems architecting.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Assign system functions to people, hardware and software.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Automation or organisational design allocates tasks without considering human capability, workload, authority, observability, training or recovery.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: The technical system passes but operators cannot control, understand, maintain or safely recover it.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Treat allocation as an architecture decision with operating context, authority, handoff/interface, performance assumptions and validation with representative users.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Human-in/on-the-loop systems; autonomy; complex maintenance; high workload; organisational handoffs.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Simple tools with direct user control may validate allocation through ordinary use tests.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Defined lifecycle/system boundary, representative lifecycle stakeholders, dependency/economic rationale and configuration/feedback mechanisms.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: Operators, maintainers, manufacturers, support, disposal, regulators and portfolio/mission actors are included only where materially affected.

PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Product variants, enabling systems, operational populations and lifecycle states must be identifiable.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Enabling-system, human, platform and mission dependencies are treated as interfaces/compositions.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Operational, maintainability, variability and mission evidence must match the claimed lifecycle scope.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: The technical system passes but operators cannot control, understand, maintain or safely recover it. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Product/mission owner, architect, operations/support, platform governance and lifecycle authorities.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Unbounded scope; speculative future modelling; commonality overreach; lifecycle stakeholder tokenism; duplication with programme/logistics functions.

PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Original form: Assign system functions to people, hardware and software. Evolved under criticism into: Evidence-based joint human–technical allocation linked to operational validation and change, not a generic 'human factors' checklist.

PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Combinatorial explosion makes exhaustive testing impossible; platform governance can constrain innovation and optimise yesterday's variants.

PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: DoD mission-engineering lineage and SoS/capability analysis.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Use mission threads and capability architectures to coordinate portfolios of systems.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A single-system programme optimises its specification while the mission depends on external systems, doctrine, data and organisations.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Delivered systems meet local requirements but do not create the intended end-to-end capability.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Define mission outcomes, threads, actors, dependencies, measures and change options across systems; preserve authority limits and validate end-to-end effects.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Defence/civil capability portfolios; mission outcomes span independently managed systems.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Ordinary products whose value is directly observable at the product boundary do not require mission-engineering machinery.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Defined lifecycle/system boundary, representative lifecycle stakeholders, dependency/economic rationale and configuration/feedback mechanisms.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: Operators, maintainers, manufacturers, support, disposal, regulators and portfolio/mission actors are included only where materially affected.

PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Enabling-system, human, platform and mission dependencies are treated as interfaces/compositions.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Operational, maintainability, variability and mission evidence must match the claimed lifecycle scope.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Delivered systems meet local requirements but do not create the intended end-to-end capability. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Product/mission owner, architect, operations/support, platform governance and lifecycle authorities.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Unbounded scope; speculative future modelling; commonality overreach; lifecycle stakeholder tokenism; duplication with programme/logistics functions.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Defence-heavy lineage, uncertain authority and potential duplication of SoS/portfolio management; outcome evidence limited.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Original form: Use mission threads and capability architectures to coordinate portfolios of systems. Evolved under criticism into: A mission-level extension activated by genuine cross-system capability dependence, not relabelling every project as a mission.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A mission-level extension activated by genuine cross-system capability dependence, not relabelling every project as a mission.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Use AI-assisted requirements, architecture and modelling under human, provenance and validation controls
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Recent AI-for-RE, AI-for-architecture and AI-for-MBSE research; no settled direct historical lineage.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Generate, classify, link or analyse engineering artefacts with large language models and other AI.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Plausible outputs, trace links or models are accepted without source authority, reproducibility, semantic validation or configuration control.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Automation scales hallucination, bias and false coherence into an authoritative engineering baseline.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Constrain use cases; preserve prompts/models/data/tool versions and sources; require domain review, deterministic checks and independent evidence for consequential claims; monitor error and drift.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: High-volume drafting/search; candidate generation; trace recovery; model queries; bounded low-consequence assistance.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Do not use AI where a deterministic parser/check/query is cheaper and more reliable, or where outputs cannot be adequately validated.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Named model questions/consumers, governance, skilled users, versioning, tool/data access, validation and sustainable maintenance economics.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: Models must represent authorised needs/use and disclose omitted stakeholders/context.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: Authority is claim-specific; tool/repository ownership does not grant truth authority.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Model, metamodel, tool, data, transformation, implementation and physical referent versions must be related.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Semantic interoperability, transformation loss, APIs and supplier/tool boundaries must be tested.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Intended use, verification, validation, uncertainty, provenance, currentness and permissible inference are mandatory for consequential use.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Automation scales hallucination, bias and false coherence into an authoritative engineering baseline. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Engineers/analysts making decisions, integrators, V&V authorities, operators and lifecycle data users.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Model volume; staleness; tool lock-in; inconsistent repositories; semantic loss; perceived-benefit bias; automated false coherence; inaccessible expertise.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Evidence is predominantly early-stage, laboratory and rapidly obsolete; reproducibility, interpretability, hallucination and governance are unresolved.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Original form: Generate, classify, link or analyse engineering artefacts with large language models and other AI. Evolved under criticism into: AI as a fallible hypothesis and retrieval/translation aid inside governed SE, never an autonomous authority for need, architecture or assurance.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: AI as a fallible hypothesis and retrieval/translation aid inside governed SE, never an autonomous authority for need, architecture or assurance.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: SysML, repositories, digital threads and twins are optional technologies. The property is decision-relevant, credible, current and portable structured knowledge.
PROPERTIES.EMPIRICAL_OR_DOMAIN_EVIDENCE: Promising but weak/contested; standards and T&E methods are still emerging.
PROPERTIES.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Current reviews show very limited industrial/longitudinal outcome evidence and immature benchmarks.
PROPERTIES.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Which AI tasks produce net benefit after review cost, and what evidence supports autonomous actions?

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Feed integration and operational evidence back into intent, requirements and architecture
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Iterative NASA SE engine, concurrent engineering and agile/operational learning.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Resolve integration/test discrepancies and update the design.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Evidence is treated only as pass/fail against a frozen baseline; discoveries about the need, requirement or architecture are classified away.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Teams fix symptoms while preserving the false premise that generated them.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Allow evidence to challenge every upstream claim under authority control; reopen intent, requirements, assumptions and architecture when observations falsify them.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Novel systems; progressive requirements; operational pilots; emergent interactions; changed use.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: A straightforward implementation defect with unchanged premise can be fixed locally.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Defined interfaces/configurations, integration authority, suitable environments, entry evidence, anomaly process and feasible sequencing.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: Integration must exercise the mission/use interactions that matter, not only convenient assembly paths.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: Someone must control integration configuration, sequence, facilities, discrepancy disposition and stop/go decisions.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Every integration result must identify products, software/data, environment, tools and configuration.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Risky semantic, timing, physical, organisational and state interfaces are first-class targets.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Integration evidence is not automatically verification or validation; claims, coverage and limitations must be stated.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Teams fix symptoms while preserving the false premise that generated them. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Integration lead, architecture/interface owners, V&V authorities, release authority and operators.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Late big-bang composition; low-fidelity surrogate overclaim; schedule-driven readiness waivers; anomaly closure theatre; component-pass/system-fail.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Upstream reopening can destabilise programmes and be abused to avoid accountability; contractual authority may resist learning.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Original form: Resolve integration/test discrepancies and update the design. Evolved under criticism into: A closed learning loop from composition/use to governing intent and decisions, with transparent rebaselining.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A closed learning loop from composition/use to governing intent and decisions, with transparent rebaselining.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Integration plans and readiness reviews are optional carriers. The property is early enough, risk-ranked composition evidence.
PROPERTIES.EMPIRICAL_OR_DOMAIN_EVIDENCE: Strong standards/guidance and portfolio criticism; causal comparative evidence limited.
PROPERTIES.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: No general rule tells when evidence invalidates a local implementation versus the governing requirement.
PROPERTIES.OPEN_QUESTIONS: What adjudication prevents both premature lock-in and endless reframing?

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Maintain accessible, current technical data and decision records
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Technical-data management, architecture rationale and digital-thread traditions.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Store and control technical data, models and records throughout the lifecycle.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Critical rationale and evidence are inaccessible, duplicated, proprietary, unsearchable or detached from current authority.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Decisions are repeated, suppliers cannot integrate, maintainers cannot diagnose and reviewers rely on presentation summaries.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Identify authoritative records by claim; preserve provenance, access, portability, retention, version and consumer; distinguish governing, working and historical information.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Long lifecycle; supplier turnover; regulated evidence; multi-tool environment; sustainment.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For small work, a well-structured repository with immutable history and clear current pointers may be enough.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Governed items, stable identifiers, change authority, status accounting and access to actual product/model/test/environment state.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: Configuration must be tied to the authorised capability, commitments and operational population.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: Authority to baseline, change, waive, release, roll back and supersede must be explicit and consequence-tiered.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: This family centrally requires exact item/composition/version/environment/evidence identity.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Interface and supplier configuration dependencies must be included in impact and release decisions.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Evidence must cite configuration and be invalidated or justified after change.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Decisions are repeated, suppliers cannot integrate, maintainers cannot diagnose and reviewers rely on presentation summaries. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Builder, integrator, release/change authority, verifier, operator, maintainer, supplier and auditor.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Frozen-baseline bureaucracy; snapshot proliferation; approved-but-unimplemented changes; hidden environment drift; incomplete impact maps; evidence over/under-invalidation.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Central repositories create lock-in and stale duplication; access control can block the very cross-boundary use intended.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Original form: Store and control technical data, models and records throughout the lifecycle. Evolved under criticism into: Technical knowledge continuity as governed access and identity, not accumulation or one-tool centralisation.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Technical knowledge continuity as governed access and identity, not accumulation or one-tool centralisation.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: CCBs, forms and baseline reviews are optional. The property is truthful identity, authority, implementation status and evidence continuity.
PROPERTIES.EMPIRICAL_OR_DOMAIN_EVIDENCE: Strong guidance and case rationale; DE measurement evidence remains immature.
PROPERTIES.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Empirical benefit and optimal data granularity remain undermeasured.
PROPERTIES.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should proprietary rights, security and lifecycle accessibility be balanced?

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Fixed one-pass V-model or waterfall lifecycle as a universal SE property
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Textbook simplification and conflation of multiple V/Vee lineages.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Complete decomposition/specification once, then implement, integrate and validate once in a fixed sequence.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Feedback and requirement change are delayed by process doctrine.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: The lifecycle representation is mistaken for the engineering mechanism.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: No retained universal mechanism; preserve only recursive decomposition/composition relationships, early V&V planning and evidence feedback.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: No general trigger. A contract or physical programme may use staged transitions, but that is a context-specific lifecycle choice.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Select lifecycle/cadence from risk, reversibility, learning and physical constraints.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Not applicable as a retained general property; evaluate the stronger surviving mechanism instead.
PROPERTIES.STAKEHOLDER_OR_MISSION_PRECONDITIONS: No artefact or process count can substitute for authoritative stakeholder/mission grounding.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_PRECONDITIONS: Approval does not manufacture technical truth.
PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Ceremonial artefacts often obscure rather than establish current identity.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Formal presence does not establish semantic or behavioural compatibility.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Completion/coverage/sign-off is not adequate evidence without a bounded claim, configuration and context.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: The lifecycle representation is mistaken for the engineering mechanism. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: No legitimate universal consumer; retain only context-specific users of the underlying stronger property.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Bureaucratic accumulation, gaming, false confidence, delayed feedback and tool/process lock-in.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Modern 15288 is lifecycle-model neutral; historical V lineages were plural and the Forsberg–Mooz Vee addressed concurrent engineering.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Original form: Complete decomposition/specification once, then implement, integrate and validate once in a fixed sequence. Evolved under criticism into: Iterative, concurrent and recursive SE with context-specific staging and controlled baselines.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Iterative, concurrent and recursive SE with context-specific staging and controlled baselines.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The candidate is itself a ceremony, caricature or overclaim. Any useful residue is represented by another admitted property.
PROPERTIES.EMPIRICAL_OR_DOMAIN_EVIDENCE: Strong historical and current-standard evidence against universal retention.
PROPERTIES.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Some high-consequence physical programmes need staged maturity and irreversible transitions, but not a universal one-pass model.
PROPERTIES.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Which physical/certification constraints justify particular gates without generalising them?

PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Review frequency and completion replace evidence quality, independence and decision consequence.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Programmes pass gates while risks, staffing limits or contradictory evidence remain.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Retain knowledge-bearing challenge and transition decisions only where the event changes authority, resources or risk.

PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Low-risk work uses direct peer challenge, automated evidence and rapid feedback.

PROPERTIES.CONFIGURATION_OR_IDENTITY_PRECONDITIONS: Ceremonial artefacts often obscure rather than establish current identity.
PROPERTIES.INTERFACE_OR_INTEGRATION_PRECONDITIONS: Formal presence does not establish semantic or behavioural compatibility.
PROPERTIES.EVIDENCE_OR_VV_PRECONDITIONS: Completion/coverage/sign-off is not adequate evidence without a bounded claim, configuration and context.

TIMELINE.EVENT: Large-network and whole-system engineering at Bell Telephone Laboratories; the term 'systems engineering' is retrospectively traced to Bell Labs in the early 1940s.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: Transmission is historically documented at institutional level, but the exact first use and modern-property mapping are not a single-origin event.

TIMELINE.EVENT: Project RAND develops from U.S. Army Air Forces work; systems analysis grows from wartime operations research toward explicit comparison of large strategic alternatives.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: Systems analysis contributed problem/alternative/effectiveness reasoning but is not coextensive with lifecycle SE.

TIMELINE.EVENT: Hall later reports an MIT systems-engineering course taught by Bell Labs' Gilman.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: Retrospective report; treat as a teaching milestone, not proof of a sole founding school.

TIMELINE.EVENT: Ramo-Wooldridge is selected for general systems engineering and technical direction for Atlas, helping establish an aerospace/defence programme-integration lineage.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: Credit and transmission span government, contractors and programme institutions.

TIMELINE.EVENT: Goode and Machol publish the first widely recognised systems-engineering textbook, focused on large-scale system design and analytical tools.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: The authors did not claim a universal general theory.

TIMELINE.EVENT: Hall publishes a plural methodology linking problem definition, objectives, synthesis, analysis, selection and communication.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: Broad methodology and philosophy; not a modern process-effectiveness trial.

TIMELINE.EVENT: Chestnut publishes systems-engineering tools and methods, further codifying analytical practice.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: Contemporary criticism noted weak cost-effectiveness and uncertainty treatment.

TIMELINE.EVENT: Missile and Apollo programmes institutionalise programme integration, configuration, interface control and system-level test; Apollo test practice broadens from compatibility checks to design verification.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: High-resource programme practice does not set a universal minimum for smaller work.

TIMELINE.EVENT: MIL-STD-499 codifies systems-engineering management planning and government evaluation criteria.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: Begins a dual inheritance: useful common interfaces and acquisition-document bureaucracy.

TIMELINE.EVENT: Rook publishes an influential software-project V-model lineage.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: Not the sole origin of all V-shaped lifecycle representations.

TIMELINE.EVENT: The German government V-Modell develops independently from other V-shaped models; concurrent engineering is formalised in U.S. defence acquisition studies.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: Do not merge independent V genealogies or equate concurrent engineering with one lifecycle graphic.

TIMELINE.EVENT: Rechtin's systems architecting and Forsberg–Mooz's project-cycle Vee sharpen architecture and decomposition/composition relationships; the Vee paper explicitly addresses concurrent engineering.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: Later textbook flattening into a one-pass V is a simplification.

TIMELINE.EVENT: Sage publishes a broad SE synthesis; Wymore publishes a formal model-based SE monograph; MIL-STD-973 codifies configuration management.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: Model-based lineage predates SysML; formalisation and CM codification do not guarantee use value.

TIMELINE.EVENT: Requirements engineering develops explicit lineages around provenance, environment assumptions, agreement, evolution and traceability; architecture decisions and SoS become distinct research concerns.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: These lineages converge with SE but are not reducible to one SE school.

TIMELINE.EVENT: NASA publishes its first agency-wide Systems Engineering Handbook.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: Guidance captures practice but is not effectiveness proof.

TIMELINE.EVENT: DoD translates concurrent engineering into integrated product and process development and multidisciplinary teams; Maier formalises SoS operational and managerial independence.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: IPT labels and SoS boards can exist without actual authority.

TIMELINE.EVENT: Ariane 5, Hubble, Mars Climate Orbiter and other investigations expose reuse-assumption, independent-test and interface-semantic failures.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: Mishaps establish failure mechanisms, not average effect sizes.

TIMELINE.EVENT: GAO knowledge-point studies and DoD SoS guidance emphasise evidence before commitment, integration, and evolutionary capability coordination.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: Government portfolio studies are observational and acquisition-specific.

TIMELINE.EVENT: SysML-era MBSE grows; NASA revises its handbook; systematic MBSE justification studies begin separating case claims from measured outcomes.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: MBSE has multiple interpretations; adoption is not itself an engineering result.

TIMELINE.EVENT: Current architecture, requirements, SoS and model-based standards are revised; ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288:2023 remains lifecycle-model neutral; DoD issues digital-engineering policy.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: Standards establish current expectations, not optimal implementation or ROI.

TIMELINE.EVENT: Systematic reviews expose weak measurement of MBSE benefits, requirements-quality definitions and SE technical debt, while controlled traceability evidence shows task-specific benefit.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: Evidence strength differs sharply by property and task.

TIMELINE.EVENT: NASA strengthens model-credibility requirements; ISO lifecycle guidance is updated; NIST advances digital-twin interoperability/trust work; SysML v2 and a standard modelling API are adopted.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: Standards and infrastructure are current; broad effectiveness evidence remains immature.

TIMELINE.EVENT: ISO publishes SE planning and agility guidance; NASA issues the 7009B model/simulation handbook; current research expands AI-assisted SE while documenting sociotechnical and evidence limits.
TIMELINE.CAUTION: This is a frontier, not a mature replacement for human authority, model validity or V&V.
